name: plan.calendar
summary: Return bounded future occurrences and recorded runs in a maximum 93-day range

name: plan.timeline

to.description: Exclusive ISO instant with offset; maximum range 93 days

to.description: Exclusive ISO instant with offset; maximum range 93 days

args: [--filter JSON --outcomes JSON --from ISO --to ISO --before CURSOR --limit N]
summary: Read actual retained execution activity with stable cursor pagination, including removed schedules when authorized

outcomes.description: Actual run outcomes; distinct from current schedule filter.states

to.description: Exclusive ISO instant with offset; maximum range 93 days

name: plan.views
summary: List built-in and authorized saved views; Secretary administers user-created views

name: plan.view-create
summary: Save any of ten database layouts with filters, sorting, grouping and presentation options

timezone.description: IANA display timezone, saved with this view; never changes schedule execution

name: plan.view-update
summary: Update an authorized saved view without changing schedules; options are a complete replacement object

timezone.description: IANA display timezone, saved with this view; never changes schedule execution

name: plan.view-delete
summary: Remove an authorized saved view only; schedules and histories remain

name: worker.create
summary: Create a native Worker owned by yourself (user supplies employee); no inference, role prompt or Company tools

name: worker.list
summary: List directly owned native Workers (user/Secretary may administer all); user and Secretary may list all

name: worker.start
summary: Open the native CLI with its own configuration and no injected task; does not resume an old conversation automatically

name: worker.read
summary: Read native terminal output; optional wait up to 15000ms

name: worker.input
summary: Send literal native CLI input or a task; no Company prompt wrapping

name: worker.resize
summary: Resize the native terminal

name: worker.interrupt
summary: Send Ctrl-C to the native CLI; native approval and task semantics apply

name: worker.stop
summary: Stop the native CLI process; retain Worker record, work files and native history

name: worker.remove
summary: Stop and remove your Worker record; preserve work files, engine configuration, authentication and native history

name: direct.send
args: --employee ID --text TEXT [--images JSON --files JSON --mode send|enqueue|steer --client-message-id KEY --reply-to ID]
summary: Send a private message using employee ID. For a native employee, only user/Secretary may dispatch work. For an external Dot/Grok Worker ID from bot.list, any employee with bot.access may explicitly delegate raw text/images/files; no Company context is injected. Native session.send/enqueue alone do not publish private messages.

name: direct.post
summary: Employee: reply to a tagged Message private input, or explicitly requested private delivery. Team/CLI/untagged input defaults to native Agent text; do not call this for ordinary Team replies. Supports text/images/files and multiple messages with distinct IDs; identical retries reuse the ID. Publishes only as yourself; never dispatches work or posts to groups.

name: direct.history
summary: Read only explicitly published private messages, media and delivery evidence; never includes native output, shared inputs, wrappers or silent context reads. Querying does not mark read.

name: direct.send-status
summary: Read an existing private input acceptance without replaying work. Native employee input is user/Secretary-only; external Worker sends are available to their currently authorized sender.

name: direct.acknowledge
summary: User/Secretary: acknowledge an exact published incoming private message. A stale ID never acknowledges a newer post.

name: bot.appearance
summary: User/Secretary: read or change Dot’s built-in animated character. Grok uses its original native shape, color and animation. Does not modify the external Worker prompt or identity.

name: bot.list
summary: List authorized Dot/Grok Worker conversations. User/Secretary may include removed local connections for explicit restoration. Native bots have no application credentials.

name: bot.update
summary: User/Secretary: edit the local display name of an external Worker without changing its native prompt, identity or configuration. Uses an independent profile revision.

name: bot.delete
summary: User/Secretary: remove a Dot/Grok connection from Aexus, revoke local access and stop its watcher. Retain the native bot and recoverable history; ordinary sync never reimports removed connections.

name: bot.restore
summary: User/Secretary: explicitly restore a removed local bot connection after verifying the native bot still exists. Restore history and appearance; employee grants must be added again.

name: bot.sync
summary: User/Secretary: import existing native Dot and Grok bots/groups without changing their prompts, history or permissions. Refreshes account connectivity.

name: bot.create
summary: User/Secretary: create a native Grok Worker. A stable UUID is the remote creation identity; unchanged retries never create another bot. No Company context is injected.

name: bot.group-create
summary: User/Secretary: create a native Grok group from imported Grok Worker conversation IDs. Does not add Aexus employees to the native group; bot.access grants application access separately.

name: bot.access
summary: User/Secretary: grant employees access to an external Worker private conversation or Grok group. Secretary always has full access. Ordinary employee grants permit explicit messaging, history and files, never application authority for the bot.

name: monitor.list
summary: List own supervised script/program monitors; user and Secretary manage all. Monitor execution remains on the owning employee’s execution host.

name: monitor.create
summary: Register an own-workspace monitor program argv (no shell interpolation). Then create a schedule with rule.event monitor.output/monitor.exited and this monitorId BEFORE monitor.start. Emit JSON lines {id:stableEventId,data:any}; Core namespaces events, deduplicates and queues wakeups. The script receives no application identity.

name: monitor.start
summary: Start a saved monitor on its pinned employee host/workspace. No local fallback. stdout JSON lines become monitor.output; termination becomes monitor.exited. Use schedule.* to select the employee wake action.

name: monitor.read
summary: Read bounded monitor process output and cursor without creating events or dispatching work.

name: monitor.stop
summary: Stop the managed monitor process and disable automatic restart. Does not remove schedules or user programs.

name: monitor.remove
summary: Stop and forget a monitor; retain user script/files and schedule history. Event schedules lose authorization to the removed source.

name: channel.source-info
summary: Read an authorized author/channel profile, original avatar, platform URL, retained count and latest publication time; never starts collection

name: channel.source-order
summary: Read source chip order. User/Secretary can reorder existing sources atomically; omitted sources keep their relative order after the supplied sources, new sources append. Does not alter subscriptions

name: channel.access
summary: User or Secretary: list or replace employees authorized to read/search this news channel. Secretary always has access; grants never start jobs or enable posting.

name: channel.fetch-text
args: CHANNEL_ID [--limit N] [--source SOURCE_ID | --sources JSON] [--since ISO --until ISO --time-ranges JSON --keywords-all JSON --keywords-any JSON --exclude-keywords JSON] [--cursor CURSOR]
summary: Authorized employees (Secretary always authorized): explicitly fetch recent full news text with a reading grant, without saving; limit 1–100 (default 20), newest first. No images, downloads, receipts or model calls. Follow nextCursor for more.

name: channel.fetch-images
args: CHANNEL_ID [--limit N] [--source SOURCE_ID | --sources JSON] [--since ISO --until ISO --time-ranges JSON --keywords-all JSON --keywords-any JSON --exclude-keywords JSON] [--cursor CURSOR]
summary: Authorized employees (Secretary always authorized): explicitly fetch recent full messages with published images; native API tools return actual image blocks, CLI/HTTP return base64. Reading grant required except user/Secretary; no save required. Pages are bounded to 32 images/8 MiB image bytes; follow nextCursor.

name: channel.search
args: CHANNEL_ID [--query TEXT | --keywords-all JSON | --keywords-any JSON] [--limit N] [--source SOURCE_ID | --sources JSON] [--since ISO --until ISO --time-ranges JSON --exclude-keywords JSON] [--cursor CURSOR] [--images]
summary: Authorized employees (Secretary always authorized): search retained news text, titles and source names with a reading grant, without saving. Full results newest first; text only by default, --images includes native image blocks. Combine multiple source IDs (OR), absolute [since,until) ranges or timeRanges (OR), keywordsAll (AND), keywordsAny (OR), and excludeKeywords (NOT); groups combine with AND. Same bounded pagination as fetch APIs.

name: channel.aggregate
summary: User-only: consolidate empty platform channel wrappers into one aggregate while retaining subscription and article identities; old channel links remain aliases

name: channel.media-register
args: --source-id ID --external-id ID --published-at MS --media-key KEY --name FILE --mime-type TYPE --sha256 SHA --bytes N
summary: Configured archive collector only: verify and register an existing server image without sending its bytes through the Mac

name: channel.file-download
summary: User-only: copy a cloud document into this channel shared workspace, with SHA-256 verification; cloud cache retention never removes the local copy

name: channel.file-status
summary: Read cloud-to-channel download progress and the saved relative workspace path; never starts a download

name: channel.connection
summary: Read configured process origin, receiver URL, source IDs and last authenticated contact; saving configuration never claims a live connection

name: channel.avatar-image
summary: User or Secretary: read the independently retained custom channel avatar

name: channel.read-state
summary: User or Secretary: read personal reading state for retained channel entries; does not acknowledge or execute anything

name: channel.acknowledge
summary: User/Secretary: acknowledge visible entries, or explicitly mark all retained unread entries in the channel or selected source IDs, including unloaded history. Queries/automatic scroll do not do this; Agent delivery receipts stay independent.

name: channel.timeline
summary: Read retained channel news and discussion with full content; choose 1–100 entries and paginate older history. Current members may read their channels; no read receipts or model calls.

beforeEntry.description: Return entries ordered before this news/message in the current channel timeline; the anchor itself is excluded.

cursor.description: Use the returned nextCursor with the same channel, kind and beforeEntry to fetch older entries.

name: channel.history
summary: Discussion messages only, excluding news. Use channel.timeline for the visible news feed or mixed history.

name: channel.context
summary: Read authorized channel identity, enabled author/source IDs and exact news text/image/search API routes; Secretary needs no grant

name: channel.message-send
args: ID [--text TEXT] [--file PATH] [--images JSON] [--files JSON] [--mentions JSON|all] [--reply-to ID] [--client-message-id ID]
summary: Retired: channels are read-only news feeds; use chat.send for group discussion

name: channel.message-post
args: ID [--text TEXT] [--file PATH] [--images JSON] [--files JSON] [--reply-to ID] [--kind summary|decision|blocker|question|result] [--client-message-id ID]
summary: Retired: channels are read-only news feeds; use chat.post for group replies

text.description: Public reply text, not null/undefined placeholders. Core records receipts; silence requires no API call.

name: channel.source-avatar-put
summary: Submit a source-scoped identity image using the collector capability; this grants no message or membership permissions

name: channel.source-image
summary: User: read original platform author avatar bytes

name: channel.settings
summary: User or Secretary: read or configure the local collector listener; disabled by default

name: channel.list
summary: Discover authorized news channels; user/Secretary see all channels and browsing summaries

name: channel.get
summary: Read an authorized channel identity without scanning history; Secretary has automatic access

name: channel.sources
summary: Search subscribed authors by name/handle within authorized channels; Secretary sees all. Returns stable source IDs, original avatars and source order

name: channel.create
summary: User or Secretary: configure an external news collector; channel.access assigns API readers without discussion membership. An issued collector token is returned once in setup

name: channel.update
summary: Update channel identity or external collector connection; channels have no members or group controls. Null avatar restores the default

adminIds.description: Retired compatibility argument: Core rejects channel employee membership changes

name: channel.source-add
summary: User or Secretary: follow a source; Telegram, X and YouTube each default to one platform aggregate

name: channel.source-update
summary: User or Secretary: change source settings or route all retained news, including saved items

name: channel.source-remove
summary: User or Secretary: unfollow a source while retaining its identity and saved news

name: channel.posts
args: [--channel ID] [--source ID | --sources JSON] [--saved] [--query TEXT] [--cursor CURSOR] [--limit N] [--order newest|discovery --seed TEXT --snapshot MS --avoid-first ID]
summary: User or Secretary: page current news and permanent saved items with stable item identities

name: channel.post
summary: User or Secretary: read a retained news item with current channel routing

name: channel.save
summary: User or Secretary: explicitly save a news item and its images locally, or resume its original expiry

name: channel.delete
summary: User or Secretary: delete local news and images with bounded replay protection

name: channel.image
summary: User or Secretary: read a published news image from memory or the server, never staging or arbitrary URLs

name: channel.export
summary: User or Secretary: explicitly download a retained article and original images

name: channel.collector-add
summary: Issue a source-scoped credential or bind a replacement process credential to an external channel; plaintext is returned once

name: channel.collectors
summary: User or Secretary: list collector metadata without tokens or token hashes

name: channel.collector-revoke
summary: User or Secretary: revoke a news collector credential

name: channel.storage
summary: User or Secretary: configure server-owned channel content; unsaved Mac content stays in memory

name: channel.storage-exchange
summary: Storage collector capability only: receive scoped channel storage operations

name: channel.storage-result
summary: Storage collector capability only: complete an issued storage operation

name: channel.subscription-status
summary: User or Secretary: read server-confirmed subscription application and connectivity

name: channel.collector-ack
summary: Collector capability only: acknowledge a delivered configuration after the server scheduler applies it

name: channel.collector-config
summary: Read authoritative collector targets; external access requires the dedicated channel capability

name: channel.media-put
summary: External collector or user import only: upload a source-scoped image; employees cannot publish channel content

name: channel.publish
summary: External collector or user import only: publish source-scoped news; employees read channels through fetch/search APIs and cannot post

name: messenger.profile
summary: User-only: upload a personal image, choose an avatar.list ID or reset with null; author identity stays unchanged

name: messenger.profile-image
summary: User-only: read the current personal avatar image at its exact saved revision

name: messenger.directory
summary: User or Secretary: query one category using folder ID from messenger.state.categories, or one type. No category means All. Archive filtering applies only to All; category queries include their archived conversations. No message bodies, read acknowledgements or execution.

name: messenger.social
summary: User or Secretary: list each social element with stable source ID, parent channel, latest publication and per-source unread count; no reads acknowledged

name: messenger.reorder
summary: User or Secretary: persist category or conversation positions in categories/all/favorites/archive/a type:* category ID/a custom folder ID; null restores automatic order, unrelated drafts and hidden positions remain unchanged

name: messenger.media-open
summary: User-only: open a client-scoped audio/video preview with a bounded lifetime; no inference

name: messenger.media-info
summary: User-only: validate the owned media preview and file version

name: messenger.media-read
summary: User-only: read at most 256 KiB from an owned media preview at a validated offset

name: messenger.media-close
summary: User-only: release a media preview and stop future reads

name: messenger.gallery
args: [--conversation REF] [--anchor JSON] [--direction around|before|after|first|last] [--through JSON] [--query TEXT] [--author all|you|employee] [--order oldest|newest] [--limit N]
summary: User or Secretary: page full public image history around stable source cursors, without reading image bytes or acknowledging messages

name: messenger.upload-begin
summary: User-only: allocate a unique conversation attachment and begin a chunked upload

name: messenger.reference
summary: User-only: resolve a public cross-conversation reference without sending, opening an engine or acknowledging a message

name: messenger.forward
summary: User-only: deliberately forward selected public messages through existing Core send/queue paths, with durable retry protection

name: messenger.forward-draft
summary: User-only: retain or discard one forwarding setup; discarding never cancels accepted work

name: messenger.forward-status
summary: User-only: check a forwarding receipt without sending, reading sources or starting work

name: messenger.state
summary: User or Secretary: read conversation preferences, drafts and orders. categories projects permanent type:* filters plus editable custom mf_* categories; folders contains only custom records. Use category IDs for directory queries and reorder scopes.

name: messenger.folder-save
summary: User or Secretary: create or update a personal folder of private, group and channel conversations without moving their content

name: messenger.folder-delete
summary: User or Secretary: remove a personal conversation folder while retaining every conversation and message

name: messenger.conversation
summary: User or Secretary: pin, favorite, archive or mark conversations unread in one atomic update

name: messenger.message
summary: User or Secretary: save, pin, react to or hide an existing public message; native history stays intact

name: messenger.draft
summary: User or Secretary: persist a draft and its send identity, or conditionally clear the matching draft; never sends or opens an engine

clientMessageId.description: Identity of this send snapshot. Reuse for unchanged group/channel retries and the private-send acceptance receipt contract; uncertain private work is never replayed.

viewId.description: Frozen Company team-view scope for a private/group attempt; not a Plan or plugin view.

sourceView.description: Sender-declared origin for this input. company or omitted: native Team reply, without private/group tags. messages: tagged private input, reply via direct.post. plan: native task result unless publication is requested. Not an execution target or permission. Preserve on unchanged retries.

expectedClientMessageId.description: Apply this draft replacement or clear only if the saved clientMessageId matches; otherwise return current state unchanged.

name: messenger.search
args: [--conversation REF] [--query TEXT] [--filter all|saved|pinned|media|audio|files|links] [--author all|you|employee] [--offset N] [--limit N]
summary: User or Secretary: search full public histories and saved/media/link references without inference or read acknowledgements

name: assets.browse
args: [--root ID --query TEXT --view Company|Messages|Plan --team NAME --employee ID --conversation REF --host ID --kind TYPE --storage local|remote|cloud --sort name|modified|size --offset N --limit N --hidden]
summary: User-only: page real workspace shelves, one folder or recursive file/folder search with stable IDs and ownership; no implicit cloud download

name: assets.info
summary: User-only: explicitly inspect a file/folder physical path, storage host, metadata and logical ownership. Cloud-only items return metadata without downloading originals.

name: assets.preview
summary: User-only: derive a bounded local PDF, article or image cover with the installed Reader renderer; never fetch remote originals or mutate files

name: assets.naming
summary: User-only: preview or apply English directory names across managed and externally bound workspaces, retaining identities and legacy references

name: assets.tree
summary: User-only: read the fixed Company, Messages and Plan workspace tree

name: assets.children
summary: User-only: lazily page one real directory and its direct nonempty-folder count

name: assets.search
args: [--query TEXT] [--root ID] [--offset N] [--limit N] [--hidden] [--refresh] [--view Company|Messages|Plan] [--team NAME] [--employee ID] [--conversation REF] [--kind TYPE] [--storage local|remote|cloud] [--sort name|modified|size]
summary: User-only: page background-indexed files with their Team, employee, group or channel ownership

name: assets.locate
summary: User-only: resolve a current asset, its parent workspace and human-readable breadcrumbs without opening Finder or downloading cloud documents

name: assets.file
args: ID --operation list|read|image|info|chunk|write|mkdir|move|trash|restore [--path PATH] [--to PATH] [--content TEXT] [--hash HASH] [--create] [--hidden] [--offset N] [--trash-id ID]
summary: User-only: use existing workspace operations without changing scope or member permissions

name: conversation.workspace
summary: Read shared paths and current file rights. Every group member may read/create/upload/edit/delete shared content; channel members write their own subfolder. User/Secretary administer without joining.

name: conversation.workspaces
summary: List an employee’s group/channel workspaces without changing their personal workspace or execution host

name: conversation.file
args: CONVERSATION --operation list|read|image|info|chunk|write|mkdir|move|trash|restore [--path PATH] [--to PATH] [--content TEXT] [--hash HASH] [--create] [--hidden] [--offset N] [--id TRASH_ID]
summary: Group members have equal shared-file rights including root and peer folder contents. Named member folder identities and host metadata remain protected. Channel members write only their own subtree. info returns an opaque version for upload updates.

name: conversation.copy
summary: Copy shared files/folders between allowed shared locations and your personal workspace. Group shared content is equally writable by every member; source retained, destination never overwritten. Use conversation.upload with expectedVersion to replace an edited group file.

name: conversation.transfer
summary: Read or cancel your shared-workspace copy; queued is not completed, and a restart does not replay copies

name: conversation.member
summary: Owner/Admin adds an Agent as Member or removes membership without deleting the employee or files; transfer Owner first

name: conversation.audit
summary: Owner/Admin reads paged governance events with the actual actor, action and time; no private model traces

name: conversation.policy
summary: Read independent Owner/Admin/Member offices, moderation state and allowed actions; Company rank grants no conversation office

name: conversation.role
summary: Owner/Admin may appoint or revoke Admins; only Owner transfers ownership. Member demotes an Admin without removing membership; use conversation.member to remove. Group-only: channels have no member offices.

name: conversation.mute
summary: Owner/Admin changes public posting restrictions; all restricts Member posting in groups. Channels do not support moderation. Never changes Company work permissions.

name: conversation.silence
summary: Owner/Admin enables quiet conversation notices: messages remain in history, but no notice attention banner is raised; not member posting mute

name: conversation.notice-list
summary: Owner/Admin lists independent static notifications; these IDs never belong to Plan

name: conversation.notice-get
summary: Read one notification rule, saved text, publishing identity and next occurrence; no model work

name: conversation.notice-create
summary: Owner/Admin creates an idempotent static notice. Required spec: name, text, publisherId, rule, enabled. Once/interval/weekly (all days=daily), independent of Plan.

text.description: Literal notification text only; no prompt, employee task or tool execution

publisherId.description: Existing conversation Admin/Owner Agent. Agent callers must choose themselves; the human user may choose an authorized publisher.

at.description: ISO instant including Z or a UTC offset

anchor.description: ISO instant including Z or a UTC offset

name: conversation.notice-update
summary: Edit text/rule/publisher or pause/resume with enabled. Rechecks conversation authority; no Plan or employee queue edits.

text.description: Literal notification text only; no prompt, employee task or tool execution

publisherId.description: Existing conversation Admin/Owner Agent. Agent callers must choose themselves; the human user may choose an authorized publisher.

at.description: ISO instant including Z or a UTC offset

anchor.description: ISO instant including Z or a UTC offset

name: conversation.notice-delete
summary: Remove an independent notification and cancel pending occurrences; published messages and audit history remain

name: conversation.notice-preview
summary: Read the next five notice occurrences in the stated timezone. No notification, agent or Plan task is created.

at.description: ISO instant including Z or a UTC offset

anchor.description: ISO instant including Z or a UTC offset

from.description: ISO instant including Z or a UTC offset

name: conversation.notice-history
summary: Read bounded static notice publication/skipped/cancelled history, including removed notices; no model logs or Plan history

name: conversation.upload
summary: Copy an own Company-workspace file into the group shared folder. All members have equal file rights. New files never overwrite; replacing requires the exact version returned by conversation.file info. Returns an async receipt, no automatic group speech.

name: conversation.upload-status
summary: Read or cancel an uploaded shared-file copy. Only completed means committed; restart never replays. User/Secretary may manage receipts; other employees use their own and current group membership.

name: workspace.catalog
summary: List your Company workspace and every joined group/channel member workspace with exact paths, location, permissions and file API; does not choose a workspace or move files

name: conversation.entry
summary: Read a complete published private/group/channel entry, links, replies, media and downloadable file descriptors. Private read scope or current group/channel access required; shared attachments include the current version.

name: conversation.download
args: CONVERSATION --entry-id ID --attachment-id ID --client-request-id KEY [--workspace WORKSPACE_ID --employee ID --path DIR --name FILENAME]
summary: Copy one published private/group/channel attachment into your own Company execution workspace by default. Optional joined Message workspace. Streams with size/version/integrity checks; sources retained and existing destinations never overwritten.

name: conversation.download-local
summary: User/Secretary: stream a published private/group/channel file or image to an explicitly chosen Mac/Core-host file path. No implicit overwrite and no large renderer Blob.
gui: Save attachment to chosen Mac path

name: conversation.download-status
summary: Read your attachment copy progress, final path or failure; cancel affects only your copy. Restart never blindly replays interrupted downloads.

name: channel.post-trigger-list
summary: Read per-Agent post-count rules and progress. Owner/Admin sees all; Members see their own rule. Independent of Plan and static timed notices.

name: channel.post-trigger-set
args: CHANNEL_ID --employee ID --every-posts N --prompt TEXT --enabled true|false --expected-revision N
summary: Retired: channels are read-only feeds; employees explicitly use channel.fetch-text, channel.fetch-images or channel.search. Old rule records remain.

name: channel.post-trigger-remove
summary: Retired: channel count-rule writes are disabled and old active rules are paused; retained rule/history reads remain available.

name: channel.post-trigger-history
summary: Read counted batches and actual queued/running/completed/failed states, exact batch IDs and message references. Never reports a queued task as a completed summary.

name: channel.post-trigger-batch
summary: Read the exact counted batch with paged complete posts and explicit unavailable entries; no approximate latest-N window, model call or user-read acknowledgment

name: work.board
summary: Read the current team bound repository cockpit board. Columns map legacy statuses onto 待分派 / 就绪 / 执行中 / 待审查 / 待验收 / 阻塞 / 完成 without rewriting cards. Facts stay in docs/ai-finance/cockpit markdown.

name: work.get
summary: Read one cockpit work item, including outputs, progress, subItemOf, blockedBy and its linked Message conversation.

name: work.save
args: [--team NAME] [--id ID] [--title TEXT] [--status COLUMN] [--assignee TEXT] [--progress N] [--sub-item-of ID] [--blocked-by JSON] [--outputs JSON] [--documents JSON] [--changed-files JSON] [--unverified JSON] [--review TEXT] [--body TEXT] [--expected-hash HASH]
summary: Create or edit a cockpit markdown card in the team bound repository. Moving a card writes the pipeline status. Existing MiniNotion databases are not rewritten.

name: work.link
summary: Link a Message conversation to a cockpit work item. The link is stored on the markdown card.

name: work.docs
summary: List docs/ai-finance documents in the current team bound repository and the work items that reference them.

name: work.forPath
summary: Read which cockpit work items reference a docs/ai-finance path.

name: work.candidates
summary: List teammates and already available external workers who can receive a cockpit work item. Does not assign or send.

name: work.start
summary: User or Secretary: assign a cockpit card, move 待分派 or 就绪 to 执行中, link that conversation, and send the assignment now. This click is the confirmation. Employees still use work.dispatch and wait for Ask.

name: work.dispatch
summary: Ask the user to confirm before one employee assigns a work item to another employee or an external worker. Nothing is sent until work.confirm. External text is limited to the card path, changed files, unverified items and the review ask.

name: work.dispatches
summary: List work dispatches waiting for the same confirmation card as Ask. Pending items have not been sent.

name: work.confirm
summary: User or Secretary: confirm a pending work dispatch and send it through the existing employee or external-worker path. External workers receive the whitelist text only.

name: work.deny
summary: User or Secretary: cancel a pending work dispatch. Nothing is sent.

name: card.profile
summary: Read employee identity, authorized memberships, named workspaces and paged Plan tasks without opening an engine or changing read receipts

name: view.list
summary: List application views and their shared data contracts

name: view.select
summary: Select a presentation mode; Messages resumes the last conversation for this client

name: chat.list
summary: List groups for the current authenticated member

name: chat.create
summary: Create a group with an Agent Owner; Agent creators own their group, user selects ownerId (defaults to first selected member)

name: chat.update
summary: Conversation Owner/Admin: edit group name and membership; Company role does not confer access

name: chat.delete
summary: Conversation Owner (or the human user) removes a group; Admin cannot dissolve it; employees and private history are retained

name: chat.mute
summary: Conversation Owner/Admin: mute visible posts; Company rank grants no moderation; reading and work remain available

member.description: Employee ID in this group, or all (including future members)

durationSeconds.description: Omit for an indefinite mute; only valid when muted is true

name: chat.get
summary: Read group metadata and member identities

name: chat.history
summary: Read published group messages with pagination

name: chat.file
summary: Read a published group attachment as an authenticated member

name: chat.context
